reasons.claim: The chain runs Talha b. Zayd, Ja'far b. Muhammad, then his father.
reasons.quote: طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

reasons.claim: Ali is quoted as the speaker of the saying after the chain, so he is the last link.
The report opens with al-Ala' from Muhammad al-Halabi.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى اَلْعَلاَءُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ

reasons.claim: Al-Halabi asks the Imam, who answers: the Imam is the last link.
The chain ends with Hammad b. Uthman asking the Imam, who answers, so the Imam is the last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ

reasons.claim: The stored chain wrongly takes words of the question as a name; the readers' seven links match the text.
The passive opening names no transmitter, so the report has no isnad.
The chain runs Asim b. Humayd, Abu Basir, Abu Ja'far.
reasons.quote: عَاصِمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ

reasons.claim: Abu Ja'far relates the story of the Prophet and Ali; the Prophet ends the chain and is not a link.

reviews.uncertainty_note: One could argue Ali, who speaks inside the told story, is a further link, but Abu Ja'far tells the story rather than relaying from Ali.

reasons.claim: Hisham b. Salim relates from a man given only by a pronoun, written as a back reference.
No speaker is named after the chain, so no Imam link can be added from this text.

reviews.uncertainty_note: The packet gives no previous report, so the man behind «عنه» cannot be inherited here.

reasons.claim: The Imam speaks with no transmitter before him, so the route is the compiler and the Imam.
The Prophet's words inside the saying add no link.
The report is passed on from Hammad b. Isa.
The Imam speaks to Hammad in the narrated encounter, so he is the last link (ruling 9).
The text is a saying alone with no transmitter.

reviews.question: a fully written chain after the text ending «مثله» (working rule 11)

reasons.claim: The first isnad has two co-transmitters at the first level and two at the third.
reasons.quote: أَبِي (رحمه الله) تَعَالَى وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي

reasons.claim: The second isnad after the text writes its own transmitters and ends «مثله», so under rule 11 it is a route of this saying.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ

reasons.claim: Under rule 11 the readers' six routes are right; if the second isnad were a remark, only its two routes would drop.
